title: Universal time and local time zone

entities.name: Universal time and local time zone
entities.description: Information element sent by the network providing time zone information for the current tracking area and tracking area list.

entities.name: Network daylight saving time
entities.description: Information element indicating when the local time zone has been adjusted for daylight saving time.

entities.name: Time zone applies to current tracking area
entities.description: Condition where the UE assumes the time zone applies to its current tracking area and tracking area list.

entities.name: Time information not accurate
entities.description: Property indicating the UE shall not assume the time information is accurate, especially when TAI list includes tracking areas from different time zones.

entities.name: Local time zone adjusted for daylight saving
entities.description: Condition where the local time zone has been adjusted for daylight saving time.

relations.description: The Universal time and local time zone IE is guarded by the condition that it applies to the current tracking area.
The Universal time and local time zone IE establishes that time information may not be accurate.
When local time zone is adjusted for daylight saving, the network must include the Network daylight saving time IE.
